The table has a central circular hole in the top surface, likely for cable management.
The table is outdoors on a wet, paved ground, possibly in a market or yard area.
In the background, there are other furniture items, including a black leather chair and a small wooden table, suggesting a resale or second-hand environment.
The table appears to be in used condition, with some minor surface marks and dust, but no visible damage.
No brand or model is visible on the table in either photo.
